                             ftol=1.e-9)

    seed = min(fits, key=lambda r: r.cost).x

    scale = 2.5 * np.r_[np.full(curves.size, mad(err[:curves.size])),

    return np.exp(best[:2]), best[2:]
'''+s[end:]
